data.overview: An awkward tween arrives at an elite water polo camp hoping to fit in, only to encounter a merciless social order. As the summer wears on, his anxiety magnifies every slight until camp life begins to feel like a psychological trap.
data.tagline: The hardest part is staying afloat.
data.title: Deep End of Summer
